## 简体中文

- 使用推荐 DNS 配置时，FakeIP 网段会根据 Sempre 主机的系统路由自动避让冲突，继续保持“使用推荐配置”勾选状态，并在禁用的输入框中显示自动选出的网段。
- 优先使用 `198.18.0.0/15` 中的空闲段；只有找不到至少 `/24` 的可用子网时，才依次选择 `172.16.0.0/12`、`10.0.0.0/8`、`192.168.0.0/16` 中的备用段。推荐模式不再显示需要手动处理的重叠警告或填入按钮。
- 系统路由变化导致实际推荐的 FakeIP 网段变化时，重启核心按钮会亮起，并在提示和重启确认框中显示旧网段与新网段。运行中的核心继续使用原网段，成功重启应用新网段后清除该提示。
- 核心、前置 DNS 和透明代理启动计划使用同一次配置生成的 FakeIP 网段，避免启动期间路由变化造成网段不一致；未启用前置 DNS 和透明代理的启动场景也保持正常。自定义 DNS 配置仍保留冲突提示和一键填入推荐网段。

## English

- With recommended DNS settings enabled, automatically avoid FakeIP conflicts with the Sempre host's system routes. Keep recommended settings enabled and display the selected range in the disabled input.
- Prefer free space within `198.18.0.0/15`. Only when no free subnet of at least `/24` remains, use `172.16.0.0/12`, `10.0.0.0/8`, then `192.168.0.0/16`. Recommended mode no longer shows overlap warnings or buttons that require manual action.
- When system route changes produce a different effective FakeIP range, highlight the core restart button and show the previous and new ranges in its tooltip and restart confirmation. The running core keeps its existing range until restart; clear the notice after the new range is successfully applied.
- Keep the core, DNS frontend, and transparent proxy startup plans bound to the FakeIP ranges from the same generated configuration, including startup without the DNS frontend or transparent proxy. Custom DNS settings retain conflict warnings and one-click range suggestions.
